'''Sionia''' was the homeworld of the [[Skup/Legends|Skups]], located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Sionian Skups were a [[Near-Human|near-human]] species with a vast range of genetic characteristics. Rumor had it that the Skups were genetically altered by another species and sold to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] ages ago.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Regarding the Hutt worlds, some quick notes of interest or things that aren't apparent from the text: Ganath is from Dark Empire II, Gar-Oth's attendants from Star Wars Republic #27 are meant to be Jilruans, Circumtore is from The Mandalorian Armor, Rorak 5 is from Jedi Quest: Path to Truth, the Parliament of Moralan is from Polyhedron #170, and Sionian Skups are from Tales of the Mos Eisley Cantina.|[[Jason Fry]], after writing ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|144|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The «Sionian» demonym was first mentioned in a [[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|short story]] written by [[Tom Veitch|Tom]] and [[Martha Veitch]] for the short-story anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'', published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[1995]].<ref name="SC" /> Later, ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' confirmed that it was the homeworld of the [[Skup/Legends|Skup]] species, called «Sionan».<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' instead named the Skups' homeworld «Sionia».<ref name="CEIII" /> The [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' gave the planet the same name and added new information about its location.<ref name="TEA" />
